title: 第13章 学习制作符箓第14章 修炼混元炼体决
content_zh:
第13章学习制作符箓
午饭后，刘长旭先去了家族藏经阁。
藏经阁收集了家族一百多年来通过各种渠道取得的绝大部分修仙典籍，是家族重地之一。为了保护藏经阁，家族为藏经阁布置了一阶上品法阵金光阵。
这座金光阵，在平时不启动，只有在受到外部攻击时，才会启动。
这座藏经阁是三层石制建筑，主要由一阶中品灵材金晶石所建。金晶石，外观呈金黄色，较青冈石硬度更高，且有良好的抗法术攻击能力，只是价格较高。
远远望向藏经阁，在阳光的照射下，金光四射，甚是美丽。
来到藏经阁前，发现守卫藏经阁的是二长老刘秋水。
“高祖父好！我今天，想找一本炼体功法。”刘长旭赶忙说道。
“你想找什么功法呢！”二长老刘秋水说道。
“混元炼体决！”刘长旭回答道。
“这是一部非常不错的炼体功法，只是易学难精，且需要耗费较多的修仙资源！在二楼第二个书架上找找吧！”二长老刘秋水说道。
“谢谢高祖父！”刘长旭道。
说完后，很快来到二层找到了记载混元炼体决的兽皮书。混元炼体决是黄阶上品炼体功法，也是家族目前最好的炼体功法了。
记载修仙功法的有玉简、兽皮书、纸质书。
玉简需要用修仙者神识刻录和读取，虽然很方便，但由于用来制作玉简的玉石，对玉质纯净度要求很高，因此价格不菲。
而制作书籍的材料，如纸张、兽皮的价格相对便宜，所以，炼气期的功法多用书籍记载。
拿到混元炼体决后，二长老刘秋水做了登记，并要求刘长旭在三个月内将本书归还，并在刘长旭的家族令牌中扣除300点家族贡献点。也让刘长旭肉疼不已。
当然，这还是家族里，在外面，这本功法最少需要2000灵石，且不易找到，这就是身在修仙家族的好处。
出了藏经阁，刘长旭直奔家族庶务堂，准备在庶务堂购买些制作符箓用的符纸、符墨。
家族庶务堂是一座五层楼的高大石质建筑。

庶务堂负责管理家族族库，发布家族任务，向族人收集和出售灵物。
族人将自己用不到的灵物出售给家族庶务堂，家族庶务堂则按照灵物价值给与相应的贡献点。
如果族人需要灵物，可以用贡献点向族库兑换自己所需的灵物。只要族库中有的灵物一般就可以兑换到。
来到庶务堂，发现今天在庶务堂值守是三伯母林氏。
content_en:
Chapter 13 Learning to make talismans
After lunch, Liu Changxu first went to the family scripture library.
The Sutra Collection Pavilion has collected most of the immortal cultivation classics that the family has obtained through various channels over the past 100 years, and is one of the important places in the family. In order to protect the Sutra Pavilion, the family arranged a first-level high-grade golden light array for the Sutra Pavilion.
This golden light array does not activate during normal times, and will only activate when it is attacked from the outside.
This Sutra Pavilion is a three-story stone building, mainly built of gold crystal, a first-grade medium-grade spiritual material. Gold spar has a golden yellow appearance, is harder than turquoise, and has good resistance to spell attacks, but it is more expensive.
Looking at the Sutra Pavilion from a distance, under the sunlight, the golden light is shining, which is very beautiful.
Arriving in front of the Sutra Pavilion, I found that the person guarding the Sutra Pavilion was the second elder Liu Qiushui.
"Hello, great-grandfather! Today, I want to find a body-training technique." Liu Changxu said quickly.
"What technique are you looking for!" Second Elder Liu Qiushui said.
"Hunyuan Body Refining Technique!" Liu Changxu replied.
"This is a very good body-training technique, but it is easy to learn but difficult to master, and it requires a lot of cultivation resources! Look for it on the second bookshelf on the second floor!" Second Elder Liu Qiushui said.
"Thank you, great-great-grandfather!" Liu Changxu said.
After finishing speaking, he quickly went to the second floor and found the animal skin book recording the Hunyuan body refining technique. The Hunyuan Body Refining Technique is a high-grade Huang-level body refining technique, and it is currently the best body refining technique in the family.
There are jade slips, animal skin books, and paper books that record the techniques of cultivating immortals.
Jade slips need to be burned and read with the spiritual consciousness of the immortal cultivator. Although it is very convenient, the jade used to make the jade slips requires high purity of jade, so it is expensive.
The materials for making books, such as paper and animal skins, are relatively cheap, so most of the exercises during the Qi refining period are recorded in books.
After getting the Hunyuan Body Refining Art, the second elder Liu Qiushui registered it and asked Liu Changxu to return the book within three months, and deducted 300 family contribution points from Liu Changxu's family token. It also made Liu Changxu feel a lot of pain.
Of course, this is still within the family. Outside, this technique requires at least 2,000 spirit stones and is not easy to find. This is the benefit of being in a cultivating family.
After leaving the Sutra Pavilion, Liu Changxu went straight to the family's general affairs hall, where he planned to buy some talisman paper and talisman ink for making talismans.
The family general affairs hall is a five-story tall stone building.
The General Affairs Hall is responsible for managing the family treasury, issuing family tasks, and collecting and selling spiritual objects to clan members.
Clan members sell their unused spiritual objects to the family general affairs hall, and the family general affairs hall will give corresponding contribution points according to the value of the spiritual objects.
If a clan member needs spiritual items, they can use contribution points to exchange for the spiritual items they need from the clan treasury. As long as there are spiritual items in the clan library, they can generally be redeemed.
When I came to the General Affairs Hall, I found that the third aunt Lin was on duty at the General Affairs Hall today.
